name: Get Outlook profile
description: Retrieves the Microsoft Outlook profile for a specified user.

select.description: User profile properties to return. Pass a list (recommended) or a comma-separated string; both become one OData $select value. Omit or pass an empty value for Microsoft Graph's default profile fields.
select.title: Select

user_id.description: The user's unique identifier or principal name. Use 'me' to get the profile of the authenticated user.
user_id.title: User Id

include_proxy_addresses.description: Whether to include proxy addresses in the response. Proxy addresses are SMTP addresses prefixed with 'SMTP:' (primary) or 'smtp:' (secondary).
include_proxy_addresses.title: Include Proxy Addresses

error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action
error.title: Error

successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
successful.title: Successful
